title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
description: CAI introduces a two-phase training process: (1) critique-revision — the model critiques its own harmful outputs according to a "constitution" of principles and revises them; (2) RL from AI Feedback (RLAIF) — a feedback model trained on these critiques generates preference labels, replacing human annotators for harmlessness. This showed AI can train itself to be safer.
authors: Bai, Jones, Ndousse, Askell, Chen, DasSarma, Drain, Fort, Ganguli, Henighan, et al. (Anthropic)
